subject: FinSecure — technical demo & procurement/security checklist
body:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finsecure.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finsecure.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinSecure — technical demo & procurement/security checklist

Hi Priya / Tom,

Thanks for the quick intro. We'd love to run a focused technical walkthrough of Redwood Inference for the engineering and security teams to cover VPC/private deployment options, key management (KMS/HSM) integrations, and SLA/latency expectations tied to model routing.

Suggested slots (PST):
- Tue 10/26 10:00–11:00
- Wed 10/27 14:00–15:00
- Thu 10/28 09:00–10:00

Alex (SE) will drive the demo; Dylan (solutions infra) is also available for deeper infra questions if we need to drill into autoscale/batching behavior. Can you confirm which stakeholders will join (engineering, security, procurement)? Also flagged below what procurement / security usually asks for so we can bring materials:
- SOC 2 excerpt (in-scope controls)
- Data residency and retention summary
- Typical commercial/PO flow for reserved capacity

I can attach a short agenda once we lock a time.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0197

---

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finsecure.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finsecure.com>, procurement@finsecure.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinSecure — technical demo & procurement/security checklist

Hi Neha,

Thanks — good context. We should include our platform security lead (Elaine Gomez) and a procurement representative. Elaine will want a run-through of VPC options and KMS at the demo and will request the SOC 2 excerpt before the call. Procurement will need a sense of MSA terms and PO timelines.

Of the slots you proposed, Wed 10/27 14:00–15:00 PST works best for our team. If Alex or Dylan cannot make that exact slot, please propose an adjacent time.

—Priya
Priya Shah
Director of Platform Engineering | FinSecure
priya.shah@finsecure.com

---

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finsecure.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinSecure — technical demo & procurement/security checklist

Hi Priya / Neha,

Thanks — we can do Wed 10/27 14:00–15:00 PST. I'll lead the demo and Dylan will join for the infra deep-dive on autoscaling, KV cache, and quantization profiles. Proposed agenda (attached):
- 5m: introductions + goals
- 20m: architecture & deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private/VPC)
- 20m: security/compliance touchpoints (KMS, network controls, audit logs)
- 10m: Q&A / procurement checklist

Attachment: [FS-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)]

A couple of prep notes so we can use the time effectively:
- If you have any test prompts or sample sequence lengths we should validate against, please share ahead of the call.
- If Elaine has specific control IDs she'd like to review (e.g., encryption at rest, access logging), list them and we'll pull the relevant artifacts.

I'll send a calendar invite once Neha confirms.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com

---

From: Elaine Gomez <elaine.gomez@finsecure.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finsecure.com, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finsecure.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinSecure — technical demo & procurement/security checklist

Hi all,

Confirmed — Wed 10/27 14:00–15:00 PST works for security. A few requests from our side:
- Please share the SOC 2 excerpt called out (control descriptions and evidence types) before EOD Monday so our risk team can pre-read.
- High-level data residency note (are there multi-region options? default region?)
- Any network diagrams for the VPC/private deployment path.

Procurement (cc'd) notes: we typically need an estimate of cost breakout (hosted vs dedicated) to start an internal spend approval. If you can include a simple slide or link to pricing ranges, that will speed review.

Thanks,
Elaine Gomez
Platform Security Lead | FinSecure
elaine.gomez@finsecure.com

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finsecure.com>, Elaine Gomez <elaine.gomez@finsecure.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finsecure.com>, procurement@finsecure.com
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinSecure — technical demo & procurement/security checklist

Great — thanks everyone for confirming. Wed 10/27 14:00–15:00 PST is locked. I've created a calendar invite and included Alex and Dylan as presenters.

Attachments / links:
- Agenda: FS-demo-agenda.pdf (attached)
- SOC 2 excerpt: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FinSecure-SOC2-excerpt (read-only)
- Pricing summary (high level) included in the invite notes; we can share a more detailed reserved-capacity worksheet after the demo if procurement wants it.

Next steps for the call:
- Elaine/FinSecure: if you can drop any specific control IDs or sample sequences by EOD Monday, Alex will pull the matching artifacts.
- Redwood (Alex/Dylan): demo + infra Q&A; Neha to coordinate PO path after the call.

If anything changes I'll update the thread. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

[Attachment: FS-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)]
[Attachment: SOC2-excerpt.pdf (PDF, 120 KB) - link provided above]
